dispatched.title: No test covers the refund-after-partial-ship path
dispatched.description: The refund flow is only tested for full-order refunds; a partial shipment followed by a refund request is untested.
dispatched.claude_md_rule: Every new code path requires a corresponding test (CLAUDE.md > Tests).
dispatched.failure_scenario: A partial shipment followed by a refund silently double-credits the customer, because the untested branch skips the shipped-quantity adjustment.
